steps.name: The Book of Champions (1/4)
steps.objective: Press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You're here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You summoned me so urgently, I thought something serious had happened.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Nothing serious. I called because there's something I need you to do for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Tell me.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Lately I have no idea what Ull is thinking. I'd like you to look into it.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You seem to be the only person he's become reasonably close to recently, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does crossing paths on a few jobs really make us close...?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I will compensate you for investigating. Money should motivate you, shouldn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go. But what should I ask him about?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Ull has always trained hard to grow stronger, but lately his ambition seems to have grown.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He has always pushed beyond his limits. He enjoys doing so. Well, that's enough about it. I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: What are you doing here? Come to bother me again? Get lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how you greet me...?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I'm telling you to mind your own business.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Let me guess. Our ever-worried eldest senior sent you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: It's obvious. My other seniors pay me no attention at all. Only she worries. Probably because so much has happened lately.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No matter what I do, I can't escape her. She finds me so easily...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: It's like being in the goddess' palm. She's always telling me not to be greedy. But I...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: If you take up the sword, you should aspire to the same heights as that old geezer—my master.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think you just called him an old geezer...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Those ears aren't completely useless, then. You caught even that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The same heights? You want to become a Champion?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: A Champion is someone who has reached a certain level through skill and experience. That's what I'm training for.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No new Champion has appeared on this continent for centuries.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Only the seven Champions, including my master, have continued to bear that title.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Isn't it about time the next generation appeared? If someone's going to become the next Champion, I want it to be me.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yuran already knows all this. That's enough.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Ull disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He must have a reason he needs to grow stronger. He already seems incredibly powerful... A Champion...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You're back. How is Ull?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You recount your conversation with Ull to Yuran, including his reference to the 'old geezer.')

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The same as ever. Even calling Master an old geezer.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Master always tells us not to grow conceited. Someday, that pride may tighten around our own throats.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I hope you never put a noose around your own neck, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Good advice, but rather chilling.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: What do you think of Champions, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Champions? I've hardly thought about them. I've only heard things in passing... They seem like extraordinary people.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There are six other Champions like my master on this continent. In Eastland, they are called the Seven Great Champions.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Beings who stand above humans through their immense power, yet are not gods like Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's a Champion...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: They say great experience and skill can lift someone to that level. The standard differs for each person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's fascinating. Ull wants to become one. What about you, Yuran? I've heard you're an incredible swordswoman.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I would sooner be cursed. Forgive me. Please forget I said that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What was that? Her face went rigid for a moment...)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Adventurer, would you be interested in a delivery commission?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, all of a sudden? I'd like a little rest...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Would this payment suffice? The client specifically requested you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they asked for me, I'll go.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Visit Lord Basil in the eastern borderlands of the Kingdom of Jude. Oh, gone already...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (I hope you take no interest in that power. But simply not wanting it does not mean it will pass you by...)

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: It's you. I haven't seen you since that incident. You seem a little stronger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while, my lord.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: I called you because of these items. Take them to the librarians at Belpa Library.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are they?

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: An artifact and a grimoire found while clearing the Sun God's Underground Altar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They look quite valuable.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: The Kingdom of Jude has no time to decipher them now. Nothing is more important than rebuilding our devastated capital.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: So I've decided to send them somewhere suitable. Belpa Library helped with the reconstruction. They will put these to proper use.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: To be honest, I know little of grimoires. But its illustrations resemble the ancient Champion stories my grandfather told me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Champions again.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: You seem to have heard a great deal about them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I've heard stories since coming to the eastern continent, but especially many today.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: Hahaha, have you? Then you must be tired of them. I won't add to it. Take these to Belpa Library quickly.

lines.speaker: 바질
lines.text: If word gets out that artifacts were found at the altar, the Deimos Order or the Kingdom of Mos may try to claim them. Do be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll deliver them.

steps.name: The Book of Champions (2/4)
steps.objective: Press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Busy, busy. Oh, Adventurer? It's been so long!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You show Pel the items you brought and explain why you have come.)

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I see. So that really was all. Dull...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: An artifact and grimoire from the eastern continent? Fascinating. Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: A Champion! A Champion! The story of a Champion from a previous age! This is incredible! Adventurer, are you interested in Champions?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You sound like you're preaching. I've been hearing so much about Champions lately. I am getting a little curious.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: That's wonderful to hear. Listen closely, then.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Adventurer, artifacts like this often seek someone worthy. Look. It's responding to you.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: This is an 'Orb Panel.' A panel set with several orbs... When certain conditions are met, certain qualifications gained, the dark orbs will light up...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So once they all light up, the seal breaks and the power passes to the worthy person?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Bingo...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: You seem to be qualified, Adventurer. Some of the panel's magic is responding to you.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: From the book, the power doesn't seem dangerous. It's about a boy who became a Champion with a righteous heart to defeat evil.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A Champion...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It may be a fitting power for you now. You've saved this world whenever danger threatened.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Adventurer, this power already seems to want to go to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I gain the orbs' power, will I become a Champion?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You'll simply gain a new power and grow a little stronger... Don't expect too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that sounded like a heavy burden... But a little stronger should be all right. If it helps me help others...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: A wise choice. I think the first panel has opened! The resolve of a worthy person must be a key to opening it!

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: For the second panel onward, follow my interpretation of the book and visit the places it describes. The grimoire seems to want that too...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Wait... I thought this book only contained a story... Apparently not...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It describes the boy's techniques and how he trained. It must be a manual too. Amazing.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Without the power of these orbs, copying the techniques won't work... We have no choice but to follow the boy's footsteps as the book describes.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: According to the book, the boy proved his skill to the lord of a mysterious land in Freios. But this castle... Where is it?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: The destroyed castle in Mirgandia...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Thank you, Liz. Adventurer, if you find the 'Lord's Token' there, bring it here. I'll see whether the panel responds.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, then.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: So this is the token the boy received when the lord acknowledged him... The Orb Panel is reacting.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: But the token seems corrupted. The orb can't absorb its power properly.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: It needs time to purify...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find another item while you work.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Wait. Let me decipher a little more. Let's see... A mage seems to have suggested that the boy become a Champion.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The boy accepted and trained for the peace of the eastern continent. After earning the lord's recognition... Ah, here!

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: A sacred land where elves dwell, and ice that never melts? Where could that be?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The place now known as Devil's Canyon. High elves once lived there and sang the gods' blessings...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Adventurer... Some creatures still disturb that place... Please deal with them as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Back already. Was it difficult?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was fine. Here's the item. What happens next? This is more interesting than I expected.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I'll tell you right away. The mage told the boy to pray in Goddess Seres' temple, fill a cup with holy water, and drink it to receive her blessing.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I've been wondering... Who is this mage?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I don't know at all, Liz... I've read tens of thousands of books in this library, but no one comes to mind.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: We know your next destination now. The temple's Holy Assembly Hall.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: There is something to watch for... Whenever you gain new power, there will be those who obstruct you...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Even against their own will... Unclean energy may gather and drive them to attack you...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: There will be obstacles before the temple as well... Defeat them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You seem to have left only a moment ago, yet you're already back... If there were a god of destruction, you would suit the role...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Liz, that's rude. Keep those thoughts to yourself.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: All right... To myself, to myself...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It took some time, but we've purified all the items you brought. Now, if I do this...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: (As Pel gently waves a hand, the materials before the panel begin to glow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, the materials are disappearing.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: ...The items you collected are all traces of the past. Lingering thoughts made visible...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The thoughts within those items have entered your panel as you follow the boy's traces.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: That opens the second panel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Four left, then. How many more items do I need?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I'll have to keep deciphering the grimoire, but it looks like about eight more for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Where to next?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Um... The capital of the Kingdom of Jude, I think. 'Together with the mage, the boy fought the forces of darkness attacking the kingdom...'

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: 'Recognized by the King of Jude, the boy received the Token of the Sun, made from the Sun God's tears...' That's what it says.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: The token is probably... inside the palace.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh! Gone already. Always in such a hurry. Liz, do you understand why this mage appeared to the boy?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I'm not sure... Not yet... Perhaps having so much to uncover makes it more interesting...?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: That's true. We should investigate further. It's about a Champion. Surely there's something more important to come? Hehe.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Pel... This book explains how to use Champion powers. Looking closely, aren't these the techniques of the current Seven Great Champions?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Hmm... Does that mean the boy could use every Champion's techniques?

steps.name: The Book of Champions (3/4)
steps.objective: Press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I've brought the book you requested... 'The Prince's Secret Seduction'...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Um, excuse me!! Please keep your voice down! I'm only running an errand, but it's embarrassing!

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It's all right, Platina. We respect your tastes. We welcome variety here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The library is rather noisy... Oh, Platina?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It's been a while, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good to see you! What brings you to the library, Platina? What's that book? 'The Prince's Secret...'?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Ahahaha, nothing at all. Her Majesty asked me to find a book. Ahahaha... No, more than one. Ahahaha.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I'll go look for some other books for a moment. Please take care, Adventurer. Ahahahaha!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you next time. Pel, I brought the item.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I'll prepare to purify it right away. Now, here's the next passage I've deciphered.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: 'In gratitude to the boy, the King of Jude held a rite so he might receive the protection of Agni, the Sun God...'

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: This time... You'll need to visit the Sun God's Underground Altar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, should I have gone straight there?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: We didn't know what came next. What if you'd made a wasted trip?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's true. I'll just go back and forth as instructed. Sigh. I'll be back, then.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I hear there are still creatures disturbing the underground altar... Feel free to make a little trouble for them...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: (Platina watches %s leave the library.)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Exactly as Her Majesty said. She warned that preparing to help a new god would be difficult. This is that very process...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I can only hope those people don't find out... Sigh...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Well done. I think we can open the third panel now. Just a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I still can't feel any power from it.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: You will probably feel it once all the panels are open...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: There. The panel is open.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Ta-da...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Liz, what was that 'ta-da' just now?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: A sound effect... Of sorts...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh, I see... Adventurer, your next destination is... Here.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: 'The mage spoke. He wished the boy to visit Waterfall Tree Forest. Nature's pure essence would cleanse evil...'

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It seems to say that receiving this 'pure essence' would help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...The mage seems to know everything. Waterfall Tree Forest is in the canyon, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Rumor has it... Some of Lux's troops still remain in White Col Canyon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll deal with them while I'm there. A little exercise won't hurt.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Always in such a hurry. Gone already. You know, Liz, don't the techniques in this book resemble those of the gods in mythology?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Champion powers... You mean they are the same as the gods' powers...?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Could it be like how we inherited the power of Leda, God of Knowledge?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: But that would mean the boy gained access to a portion of every god's power.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I've brought the book you requested. 'The Handsome Minister's Holiday'...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Again, it's not for me. Her Majesty sent me on an errand... Ahahaha...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Why not borrow them all at once? We can certainly trust the Silvaria Empire with our books.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: How about 'The Brazen Butler and His Wistful Young Master,' 'There's More to Me Than Cleaning, Dear Maid,' or 'The Little Knight and the Older Lady'...?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Aaaaaah! S-stop! Please don't read those embarrassing titles in your perfectly clear librarian's voice!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Platina, borrowing those sorts of books again?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: ...Th-those sorts of books?! Oh, well, that's true. No use making excuses. Sigh. I'll go browse the technical books...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe. Teasing her is rather fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Liz, Pel. I brought the item.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: This is remarkable. It's only a lingering thought from long ago, yet enough energy remains to purify something even now...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: ...Still, it is only a tool for opening the panel.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: True. Oh, Adventurer, I'll tell you where to go next.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At this point, Jewel Tree Forest?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Ding-ding-ding...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't that a little gloomy for a correct-answer chime?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Ding... Ding... Ding...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Never mind that. Listen to the next part. Let's see... 'Because of the ancient dragon Gluart, the mage...'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gluart... I think I've heard that name somewhere...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: A greedy dragon of the eastern continent... He caused great harm to people, until Ziskad defeated him upon becoming a Champion.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: In this book, the mage tells the boy that villagers are suffering and asks him to meet Gluart.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Moved by the boy's courage, perhaps, Gluart promised not to torment people and gave him a Tear of Light made from a jewel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The more I learn about this boy's righteous deeds, the more he reminds me of myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, all right. I was only joking. I didn't expect such stony looks... I'll be going. Sniff. You're so mean!

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: There are still creatures disturbing Waterfall Tree Forest on the way... Gone already... Perhaps that goes without saying...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: So this is the 'Tear of Light' Gluart gave the boy... Brilliant and beautiful.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: That was truly instantaneous... To think even the fourth panel would be so easy...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Thank you for all your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What do you mean by that...?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: You've worked hard coming back here so often, so we've arranged for the last two panels to be opened in the eastern continent.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Asma?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: It's been a while. The alliance asked me to help you, so here I am.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Your ability is... remarkable, Asma... We will keep the book safe here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. If the library keeps the book, how will you decipher it? You'll be staying in Lumen...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hehe. I've read and memorized it all. I can take my time deciphering it.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: She's as much of a genius as I am. An expert in history and an excellent mage...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Oh, please. I learned from the Sisters too, so I can purify the items as well!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: These people are rather more shameless than I expected...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: This grimoire is fascinating. A Champion from before the Seven Great Champions... Well worth researching.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The mage seems to be from neither Eastland nor Freios. The manner of speech is different.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: And the description mentions pale skin, silver hair, and purple eyes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That sounds rather like someone I know.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The mage told the boy to train where the Training Forest stands today.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: At the time, no one had noticed that place's unusual energy. Yet the mage recognized it.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Wooow...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Something seems to have happened to the boy while he trained alone there, but I don't know what.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It says his sword broke and he was badly wounded.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should go there. That's on the Floating Island, right?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes. Come find me afterward. I'm always in Lumen, so don't get lost! Oh, and you'll have to persuade Bilbradha. Understood?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Asma is as impatient as the adventurer... Gone already...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The boy in the book... Doesn't he resemble that person?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: (Liz nods.)

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I think this is worth studying. Help me, Liz. But will we be all right?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Perhaps... We are here to do that sort of thing...

steps.name: The Book of Champions (4/4)
steps.objective: Press the [Complete Quest] button to finish the quest.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Over here, Adventurer. Oh, so this is the item. I've never seen it before. It feels quite unusual.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: That reminds me of something.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I heard Lord Ziskad found something after defeating Gluart long ago. Perhaps it was that 'Tear of Light' you found earlier. I'm not certain...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. About the alliance helping me... There's something I'm curious about.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Of course. Tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You'd expect power connected to Champions to attract attention. Yet everything is quiet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even Ull, who wanted that kind of power, has been surprisingly quiet. And I'm not exactly discreet in my travels.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I believe Yuran is quietly taking care of things, so you can receive that power without interference.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yuran? For me?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Perhaps because you help Lady Iris with her work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't understand that woman at all.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I simply do what I'm asked. Now, I'll tell you the next part of the grimoire.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The mage sends the boy somewhere to cut down his fear. It's a place you know well, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Will you go? You may find something there. Perhaps you could cut down your own fear while you're at it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels almost as though the grimoire and panel want me to...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Perhaps this is how the panel's power acknowledges its master?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Be careful. Some of the guild members you defeated still remain there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They're hardly a threat. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Then I'll decipher the rest...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: You're back. I'm glad nothing went wrong. And that must be the item you're holding.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: A mirror filled with darkness, reflecting only shadows. It holds a mix of unease and loneliness, so intensely I can almost feel it myself.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The boy must have suffered greatly. Still, he seems to have cut down his fear, leaving those feelings behind there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did the boy choose such a difficult path?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Perhaps for a reason like the one that led you to begin your journey?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. I don't know. There's no single right answer to the choices people make.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Well said. I've just finished the purification with the magic stone our school is so proud of.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: With purification complete, the fifth panel has opened. You're almost there. A little more effort, and they'll all be open.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will you tell me the next part, then?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Impatient as ever. Of course. After cutting down his fear, the boy rose to a new level.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: They say he met another self and entered his own mind. There he met many spirits, heard their stories, and...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Another anxious part of him wanted to curse everyone and escape into the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This story sounds familiar too.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: But if we follow the book, you would have to enter someone's mind. Is that even possible?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back. I'll deal with any spirits blocking the way too.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: What? How will you get there? Oh, gone already... Heading straight off like that, have you been there before? What a remarkable person.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: You really did visit a place of spirits. I never expected you to bring back the Spirit's Wing so quickly.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: It's actually an object formed from lingering thoughts, but it's beautiful. And the panel is responding...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was more troublesome than I expected.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Then I'll tell you where to find the last item for the final panel.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: While wandering within his mind, the boy encountered a primordial being that stirred his fear.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: ...It seems not to have belonged to our world. After meeting it, he returned to reality.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This definitely sounds like a story I know...)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Afterward, he was active as a Champion. That's all I know. Yet I feel there should be more...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I definitely read the whole book. I don't know why it feels that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do I need to go back to the library, then?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I'm afraid so. I'll send a message separately. Once you've found the last item, go to the library.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The librarians may know what follows.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I'll be off, then. Thank you for all your help.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: You're back, Adventurer. Well done finding the last item.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: A pearl holding terrible darkness... I sense magic almost too great to bear...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Fortunately, we can still purify it. If you'd been even a little later...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What would have happened?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I'm not certain, but you might have been sucked into a rift to another dimension.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa... How can you say something so terrifying without blinking?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: ...That is what the item you're holding is for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A power that encompasses even time and space...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: All the panels are open now. Can you feel the power? There's no magic left in the grimoire or Orb Panel.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: We will keep the grimoire here... And as a precaution, we made a separate book of the sections describing the techniques.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Here you are. It's not in the ancient language, so you should be able to read it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll put it to good use. I can train using this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, one question. Do you know what happened to the boy afterward?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: That surprised us too. When the fifth panel opened, writing began to appear on pages that had been blank!

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Curious... I want to hear...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Then I'll read it. 'Amazed by the boy's growth, the mage told him to become a worthy man and protect the continent, then vanished.'

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: 'The boy used his power to help those in need and act justly. He took up his weapon and went to the battlefield to oppose a great evil... But...'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened next? Why the pause?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: 'A vast white wolf suddenly entered the battlefield and bit the boy's throat. His white hair was stained with blood...' Oh, it ends here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there nothing else? That's the end?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: This... seems to be the end. I didn't expect the story of a Champion from a previous age to end like this...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Liz, there's nothing we can do except research it and find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll have to meet an actual Champion someday to hear the full story. See you later, both of you.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: See you later, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Goodbye...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suddenly feel strange... What is this? As though I've become a Champion myself...)
You are not imagining it, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Harmonia? What are you doing here?
I am not Harmonia. She has come only to convey my message.
Only you can see Harmonia's form and hear her voice now, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
Hehe. For convenience, shall we say I'm a mage?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me you're that mage? Wouldn't you be nearly a thousand years old? Or perhaps a Champion... What do you want?
Oh, you regained your composure surprisingly quickly. I had something to say... no, a favor to ask, so I came before I fall asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know you're no ordinary person.
Then this will be quick. Protect the child my younger sibling chose. That is my only request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your sibling? Chose? Which child? What are you talking about...?
Hehe. You needn't understand now. You will do it anyway.
And one more thing. The power you gained through the Book of Champions will open a new path in your future.
But others will feel differently. They will envy your power. Be careful. It is a power my siblings left for the sake of the world.
With this new power, you can now use the techniques of the seven current Champions.
For now, you may only imitate them. But with steady training, you will wield them as your own.
Then I hope we can meet properly before long, Adventurer...
(Harmonia's image and the mage's voice disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait... Gone already.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who could that be? Anyone who can appear through a spirit king's body is no ordinary being...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be a god, like Goddess Seres...?
